cc:Work.dc:title: Track map for Barbagallo Raceway (formerly Wanneroo Park) in Australia
cc:Work.dc:description: Created in Inkscape. It is known that at least some turns have names. Those aren't shown as no identification can be found as to which name is which. It is believed that "Cat Corner" refers to one of the ends of the main straight. However, I don't know which turn that is. Wikipedia only mentions that "Cat Corner" is damaged during drifting.

text.tspan: Map based on data from April 6th, 2006
